name: Maitetsu
source:
Set in Hinomoto, a fictional version of Japan, where railway travel served as the primary form of transport for a long time. Each locomotive was paired with a humanoid control module, so-called Raillord, that aided the train operator. However, many rail lines had been discontinued due to the rising popularity of ‘aerocrafts,’ a safe and convenient aerial mode of transport. As such, their accompanying Raillords also went into a deep sleep.

Soutetsu had lost his entire family in a rail accident and was adopted into the Migita household, which runs a shochu brewery in Ohitoyo city. He returned to his hometown to save it from the potential water pollution if they accepted the proposal to build an aerocraft factory nearby. He woke up the Raillord Hachiroku by accident and became her owner. They agreed to help find her lost locomotive for different purposes, with the help of his stepsister Hibiki, the town’s mayor and local railway chief, Paulette, and others.

[Translated from [url=http://www.lose.jp/maitetsu/story.html]Official Site[/url]]
translation:
以虚构的日本日之本为背景，铁路旅行长期以来一直是那里的主要交通方式。每个机车都配有一个人形控制模块，即所谓的Raillord，为火车操作员提供帮助。然而，由于“飞机”（一种安全便捷的空中交通方式）的日益普及，许多铁路线已停运。于是，随行的铁道领主们也都陷入了沉睡。

相铁在一次铁路事故中失去了全家，并被在大丰市经营一家烧酒厂的御田家族收养。如果他们接受在附近建造飞机工厂的建议，他就会回到家乡，以拯救家乡免受潜在的水污染。他偶然唤醒了铁路领主八六并成为了她的主人。他们同意在他的继姐妹响、镇长兼当地铁路局长保莱特和其他人的帮助下，出于不同的目的帮助寻找她丢失的机车。

[翻译自[url=http://www.lose.jp/maitetsu/story.html]官方网站[/url]]
